transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As part of our normal month-end capital distribution routine, I need to review the proposed $6,000,000 upstream dividend from our regulated subsidiary before I authorize the payment. The subsidiary currently reports $8,000,000 in distributable retained earnings, so on the face of it the distribution appears supportable. Before I give final sign-off, I'd like to hear from each of you on any constraints or concerns: capital risk, are there any regulatory capital or solvency issues we need to flag? Tax, any withholding or tax implications on this upstream payment? And subsidiary controllership, can you confirm the retained earnings figure and that there are no other restrictions or encumbrances I should be aware of?
